description: This file defines the ServiceQuotasClient class in the Aws\ServiceQuotas namespace, which serves as a client for interacting with the AWS Service Quotas service. It provides method annotations for various operations such as associating templates, requesting quota increases, listing quotas, and managing tags.

classes.name: ServiceQuotasClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the AWS Service Quotas API, extending AwsClient with specific methods for quota management.

methods.name: associateServiceQuotaTemplate
methods.description: Associates a Service Quota template with the current account.

methods.name: deleteServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestFromTemplate
methods.description: Removes a quota increase request from the template.

methods.name: disassociateServiceQuotaTemplate
methods.description: Disassociates the Service Quota template from the account.

methods.name: getAWSDefaultServiceQuota
methods.description: Retrieves the default service quota value.

methods.name: getAssociationForServiceQuotaTemplate
methods.description: Gets the association status for the Service Quota template.

methods.name: getRequestedServiceQuotaChange
methods.description: Retrieves the details of a specific quota change request.

methods.name: getServiceQuota
methods.description: Gets details about a specific service quota.

methods.name: getServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestFromTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a quota increase request from the template.

methods.name: listRequestedServiceQuotaChangeHistory
methods.description: Lists the history of quota change requests.

methods.name: listRequestedServiceQuotaChangeHistoryByQuota
methods.description: Lists quota change requests by quota.

methods.name: listServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestsInTemplate
methods.description: Lists all quota increase requests in the template.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: putServiceQuotaIncreaseRequestIntoTemplate
methods.description: Adds a quota increase request into the template.

methods.name: requestServiceQuotaIncrease
methods.description: Requests an increase for a specific service quota.
